decisions.reason: The safety shoe line sits in the firm's core business, where in-house production and existing distribution keep carrying costs low, and two years of modest visibility have not yet resolved its value, so the option is worth holding.

The ergonomic series still has its own page, which signals continued commitment and favourable early results in line with the firm's focus on evolving workplace needs, so management should keep it and consider expanding it.
Pruning the other insoles concentrates the firm's insole strategy on this moulded flagship, which raises its expected value and argues for further commitment rather than abandonment.
